summary: Menu UI action dispatcher. Switches on an integer action id a2. For ids 0-8 the id is stored into the menu state action slot (this->data + 0xF8C). For ids 9-13 it delegates to sorted-list / sprite-overlay / linked-list helper routines on the same menu data block. Every path returns 1.

operations.description: Switch dispatch on action id a2 across cases 0-13 with a default path, via the jump table jpt_4B9DB0.
Cases 0-8: store action id a2 into menu state action slot at (this->data + 0xF8C).
Case 9: insert a zero-valued node into the sorted list rooted at *this via SortedLinkedListInsert.
Case 10: clean up the sprite overlay display list via SpriteOverlayDisplayListCleanup.
Case 11: destroy the linked list via LinkedListDestructor_8480.
Case 12: seek the sorted list by value via SortedListSeekByValue.
Case 13: search the list by float threshold via LinkedListPrioritySearchByFloatThreshold, then falls through to the common return.
Return constant 1 on every path, including the default case.
